# Vendored Agent POSIX SDK

`thinkthread-agent-posix-0.1.0.tgz` is built from
`aideveloper/capsule_public` tag `v0.1.0`, commit
`e7287acc187b4b17a9d2a0c8cad2f75f64ed538f`, directory
`sdk/agent-posix/ts`.

The archive is used as the reproducible development dependency and as the
ThinkThread profile installer's default runtime payload. Its upstream
MulanPSL-2.0 license is embedded in the archive.
